## Rules
1. **React Query Hook Encapsulation & Parallel Coalescing:** All server state and mutations across ATS Diagnostics (`use-ats-diagnostics.ts` running `Promise.all` across `/v1/match/ats-scan`, `/v1/match/talent-shortlist`, and `/v1/match/interview-kit`), Expert Review (`use-expert-review.ts`), Job Tracker (`use-job-tracker.ts`), Analytics (`use-analytics-dashboard.ts`), and Salary Benchmark must use `@tanstack/react-query`—never `apiClient` inside `useEffect`.
2. **MoMo Polling Cleanup:** `momo-checkout-dialog.tsx` must halt status polling immediately when the dialog closes or order status reaches `PAID`.
3. **Kanban & CV Studio Integrity:** Preserve the 5 Kanban columns (`TARGETING`, `TAILORED`, `APPLIED`, `INTERVIEW`, `OFFER`), Funnel Velocity & Offer Probability banner (`data-testid="job-tracker-velocity-banner"`), Live CV Studio ATS Readability & STAR Density Bar (`data-testid="cv-studio-ats-density-bar"`), and A4 print preview dimensions in `cv-studio-preview.tsx`.
4. **Career Intelligence & SaaS Telemetry Selectors:** Preserve `data-testid="career-upskill-roi-card"` in `salary-benchmark/page.tsx`, `data-testid="smart-expert-matcher-banner"` in `(public)/expert-review/page.tsx`, `data-testid="market-pulse-jds-badge"` in `ats-diagnostics/page.tsx` (`GET /v1/match/market-pulse`), and `data-testid="unit-economics-banner"` + `data-testid="bi-star-schema-panel"` in `admin/analytics/page.tsx`, invalidating `["ats-market-pulse"]` and `["analytics-dashboard"]` after ATS/Kanban/Bookmark mutations (`BEL-154` / `BEL-155`).


## Known Traps
- **Auth Gate on Booking:** Anonymous users clicking Expert Review booking or adding Kanban jobs must be prompted to authenticate before mutating server state.
